# FINAKI

> FINAKI is an independent design studio founded by Imran Shiundu — one person, no handoffs: strategy, identity, web design and code from the same hands. Based in Nairobi, working worldwide.

- Founder: Imran Shiundu — founder page: https://finaki.co.ke/founder
- Contact: imran@taptap.africa — email only, read by Imran, answered within 24 hours
- The founder file (every venture, one page): https://www.imranisdev.top/founder
- Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Website Strategy, Website Design, Webflow Development, 3D Development
- The studio's own site is the sample: strategy, identity, copy and code, built in-house end to end
- The properties the studio's founder also runs (design and engineering in-house, every one live at its own domain):
  - TapTap Africa — cashless payments for live events (product of Olarfe Africa; built and operated by the TapTap team) — https://taptap.africa — founder
  - Inside Nairobi Tours — private Nairobi tours & JKIA layover safaris (under Inkind Experiences) — https://insidenairobitours.com — co-founder · tour coordinator
  - Explore Kibera Tours — community-led Kibera walking tours (under Inkind Experiences) — https://www.explorekibera.com — co-founder · tour coordinator
  - Rush Burgers — online ordering platform (product of Alibunbun Grupp OÜ) — https://rushburgers.co.ke — developer & technical lead
- Process: 01 Uncover your story → 02 Shape your digital presence → 03 Send it into the world
- Pricing: fixed, outcome-scoped proposals — one number covering strategy, design and development
- Pages: Home (https://finaki.co.ke/), About (https://finaki.co.ke/about), Founder (https://finaki.co.ke/founder), Portfolio (https://finaki.co.ke/portfolio), Services (https://finaki.co.ke/services), FAQs (https://finaki.co.ke/faq), Contact (https://finaki.co.ke/contact)
- FAQ: https://finaki.co.ke/faq
